title: Deleted calibration is not removed on watch in forced mode
symptom: When running the collector on the watch, a calibration deleted on the phone is not removed from the watch. The calibration remains on the watch and causes wrong data. 'Refresh DB' does not help, and 'Reset wear db' causes duplicate historical readings.
cause: The issue appears to be related to the watch running as collector and not syncing calibration deletions. The duplicates may be caused by merging data from watch and phone with different calibration sets, and possibly by the 'Rewrite History' setting.
fix: The thread does not provide a definitive fix. Suggestions include turning off 'Rewrite History' (which did not help), resetting wear DB followed by refresh DB (causes duplicates), and for Dexcom, resetting calibrations via 'Stop Sensor' and 'DON'T STOP, JUST RESET THE CALIBRATIONS' (not confirmed for Libre). The issue was closed due to inactivity.
evidence_quote: I have now turned off "rewrite history ticket". It did not help...
